description:
Buying a business is exciting—but what happens after the deal closes? One of the biggest challenges new owners face during mergers and acquisitions is keeping key employees from walking out the door. In this video, we’ll cover the most effective strategies to retain talent, build trust, and create a smooth transition that keeps your new team engaged and motivated.

From clear communication to cultural alignment, we’ll walk you through the critical steps every new owner should take in the first 30, 60, and 90 days post-acquisition. Learn how to avoid common mistakes that trigger turnover and instead build a foundation for long-term success. Whether you’re a first-time buyer or an experienced operator, this guide will help you keep your most valuable asset—your people.

https://www.linkedin.com/in/sara-sharp-9a2a98b/
